snippet.title: The Boba Teashop | Cozy Horror Console Announcement Trailer | Switch & PS5
snippet.description:
🧋 The Boba Teashop is coming to consoles!
The Boba Teashop is coming to Nintendo Switch and PlayStation 5.

A cozy psychological horror game where you own and manage a boba tea shop… but something feels off. Prepare boba teas, serve customers, and expand your menu as tension slowly builds through an eerie atmosphere and unsettling events. You play as Risa, a woman who leaves corporate life behind to follow her dream—only to discover that her new beginning hides something far more disturbing.

🎮 Wishlist, follow, and stay tuned for more updates.
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10017832
